# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P1](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

He is low in stature, heavy-set, and bald except for a small strip of hair encircling his ears. He has bulging blue eyes and a circular face that turns violet when he is furious. He is extremely sensitive about his hairless scalp.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046)_

## Personality

Mr. Pettifer is an eccentric, candid, and quick-tempered man who prides himself on speaking bluntly and telling the direct truth. He can be hasty, impatient, and stubborn, often reacting with sudden outbursts of anger, though he quickly regains his temper and can prove gentle, amiable, and generous. He holds a deep aversion to female meddling and gossip, though he appreciates good company and quiet neighborliness. Beneath his crusty exterior, he possesses a soft spot for young people who bring a sense of youth back into his life.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P23](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0023), [v2 c1 P25](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0025), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c4 P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 c4 P40](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0040), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)_

- To keep his farm and livestock protected from trespassing animals  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015)</sub>

## History

After buying Mr. Bell's farm in Brierley, Mr. Pettifer quickly established a reputation as a solitary, stingy crank who kept his own house, maintained irregular eating habits, avoided washing dishes, and kept a foul-mouthed parrot named Nutmeg. He frequently clashed with neighbor Nell Harcourt over her cow straying into his oatfield. However, when Nell accidentally sold his cow and came to apologize with a cake, he forgave her cordially, took her cow in trade, and formed an enduring friendship with her. He routinely provided advice and honest critiques on Nell's teaching methods and writing endeavors. Following the death of Nutmeg by a lightning strike, a prank letter in a newspaper prompted his estranged wife, Emily, to arrive in Brierley. Reunited with Emily, Mr. Pettifer adopted a cleaner, more orderly lifestyle and regularly attended church, while maintaining an armed neutrality toward local busybody Agatha Sowerby. He was later invited to attend Nell's wedding.

## Background by volume

- Moved from New Brunswick to Brierley after buying Robert Bell's farm  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Separated from his wife Emily after a marital dispute and moved away alone  <sub>[v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 c25 P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)</sub>
- Was routinely flogged by his schoolmaster during his own school days  <sub>[v2 c4 P36](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0036)</sub>
- Has a brother who was a seafaring sailor  <sub>[v2 c3 P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m a crabbed, lonesome, crusty old chap, but I feel young again because of something about that little girl . . . and having that sensation repeated once in a while is something I’d like, since it’s so pleasant.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

> Spare the rod and spoil the child.  <sub>[v2 c4 P36](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0036)</sub>
